name: Kari Woodsmock (the king’s daughter)
description: A gentle princess driven from her home by her cruel stepmother, she endures hardship, keeps three strange tokens, and hides in a wooden smock while fate leads her to a prince.
visualPrompt: A young fair-skinned woman with long hair, calm determined eyes, and a soot-smudged face from kitchen work, wearing a stiff, roughly made wooden smock that looks like slats tied into a garment; later glimpses of her in a radiant gold-and-diamond gown with a delicate gold shoe

name: The Blue Bull
description: A powerful enchanted bull who feeds and protects Kari, fights three trolls, and leaves behind a hidden source of magic that continues to aid her.
visualPrompt: A large muscular bull with a deep blue coat that shines like polished stone, gentle intelligent eyes, strong curved horns, and a noble bearing; an air of quiet magic around him

name: The Stepmother Queen
description: A jealous, calculating queen who starves and beats her stepdaughter and schemes to have the blue bull killed to destroy Kari’s secret help.
visualPrompt: A stern middle-aged queen with sharp features and cold eyes, richly dressed but with a harsh, rigid posture; hands adorned with heavy rings, expression tight with envy

name: The Prince
description: The castle’s young prince who scorns the clattering kitchen girl yet falls hopelessly in love with the mysterious church-going lady and searches for her through the lost gold shoe.
visualPrompt: A young nobleman in fine but practical court clothing, dark hair neatly kept, intent searching gaze, holding a single ornate gold shoe with reverent wonder

name: The Nine-Headed Troll
description: The terrible guardian of the golden wood, whose many heads keep reviving one another until the blue bull finally defeats him in a brutal week-long struggle.
visualPrompt: A towering monstrous troll with nine snarling heads clustered on a massive body, each face different and grotesque; skin like rough rock, eyes burning with rage, framed by the gleam of a golden forest
